title: Global uniqueness for isotropic elasticity
description: The displacement-to-traction map of an isotropic elastic body determines both Lamé moduli: on a bounded connected domain in R^3 with smooth boundary, smooth moduli with μ > 0 and 3λ + 2μ > 0 are recovered from the map from boundary displacements to boundary tractions. Adjoining the divergence as an unknown gives a system with principal part the Laplacian; exact solutions of complex geometrical optics type have leading terms governed by a transport equation; a comparison of the transport equations of the two media depends holomorphically on the direction, which ranges over a conic in the complex projective plane, and a bundle over this conic forces it to be the identity. The course is an exposition of OpenAI's proof (2026). Boundary determination, interior elliptic regularity, a Carleman estimate for the Laplacian and holomorphic frames over a disk are used as named results from the literature.

units.title: Boundary jets and the transfer of solutions
